entities.summary: Aksumite, a notable figure in the history of Ethiopia, associated with Ancient Ethiopian Civilisations (980 BCE–400 BCE). Preceded by D'mt Kingdom and Land of Punt Connections. Their legacy influenced Axum Tsion Church and Ethiopian tradition of the Ark of the Covenant.
